title: A Car Once Broke the Sound Barrier at 763 mph in the Desert

scenes.text: A car once drove faster than the speed of sound.
October 1997. Black Rock Desert, Nevada. Driver Andy Green.
The car was called ThrustSSC. It hit 763 miles an hour.
Two jet engines gave it 50,000 pounds of thrust.
It burned nearly five gallons of fuel every second.

description:
On 15 October 1997 ThrustSSC, driven by RAF pilot Andy Green, became the first car to break the sound barrier, hitting 763 miles an hour in Nevada's Black Rock Desert.
Two jet engines produced about 50,000 pounds of thrust and the car burned roughly 4.8 gallons of fuel every second.
Would you ride in it? Tell us.
first_comment: The record still stands today. Do you think a car will ever go faster?
